pages.title: Ministry of National Defence (Greece) - Wikipedia
pages.excerpt:
The**Ministry of National Defence**([Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_language):Υπουργείο Εθνικής Άμυνας,[romanized](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romanization_of_Greek):*Ypourgeío Ethnikís Ámynas*, abbreviatedΥΠΕΘΑ,*YPETHA*), is the civilian cabinet organisation responsible for managing the[Hellenic Armed Forces](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Military_of_Greece), the[leader](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Commander-in-chief)of which is, according to the[Constitution](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constitution_of_Greece)(Article 45), the[President of the Republic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_Greece)but their administration is exercised only by the[Prime Minister](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Greece)and the[Government of Greece](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government_of_Greece). It is located at 227-231 Messogion Avenue, in the Papagos camp (Pentagon) in Athens, between Papagos and Holargos.

Today is hierarchically ranked 3rd in the rankings
